description: Get move details by name or numeric ID — type, damage class, power, accuracy, PP, priority, target, stat changes, status-effect chance, and full English effect text. Set include_learners=true to include the list of Pokémon that can learn the move. Move names are available from pokeapi_get_pokemon when include_moves=true.

identifier.description: Move name in lowercase hyphenated form (e.g. "flamethrower", "close-combat") or numeric ID as a string.

include_learners.description: Include the list of Pokémon that can learn this move. Defaults to false as the list can be large.

name: pokeapi_get_move

accuracy.description: Accuracy percentage (0–100). Null for moves that always hit.

damageClass.description: Damage class: physical, special, or status. Null when unavailable.

effectChance.description: Secondary effect chance percentage. Null when not applicable.

effectText.description: Full English effect description. Null when unavailable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The identifier resolves to no move in PokéAPI. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

learnedByPokemon.description: Pokémon names that can learn this move (populated when include_learners=true).

learnersIncluded.description: True when the learner list was requested, including when no learners are known.

power.description: Base power. Null for status moves.

priority.description: Priority bracket (positive = higher priority, negative = lower).

shortEffectText.description: Short English effect summary. Null when unavailable.

statChanges.description: Stat stage changes caused by this move.

items.description: Stat stage change entry — affected stat and magnitude.

change.description: Stat stage change (positive = buff, negative = debuff).

title: Get Move
